name: talentsia-do
description: Ten bilingual skills for capturing, organizing, planning, preparing, doing, following through and reviewing work.

interface.longDescription: Talentsia Do includes ten free bilingual productivity skills sharing one trusted method. The same plugin bundles an optional read-only Talentsia connection for current Premium access and the Plan My Day pilot. Free workflows remain available without signing in. Connected access requires personal Talentsia OAuth consent; no private Premium source, storage, Work seat permissions or automatic monitoring are included.
defaultPrompt: Use Clear My Head to capture what is on my mind.
Use Plan My Day to choose feasible work for today.
Use Review to reconcile my commitments.
